Configure a 2D transient incompressible laminar flow-past-cylinder simulation using pimpleFoam.
The mesh is one cell thick in the z-direction.
In constant/polyMesh/boundary, the frontAndBack patch is defined with type empty.
In 0/U, the frontAndBack boundary condition is type empty.
The inlet patch uses type fixedValue with value uniform (1 0 0) for U and type fixedValue with value uniform 0 for p.
The outlet patch uses type zeroGradient for U and type fixedValue with value uniform 0 for p.
The cylinderWall patch uses type noSlip for U and type zeroGradient for p.
The cylinder diameter is 0.05 m, the inlet velocity magnitude is 1 m/s in the x-direction, and the kinematic viscosity nu is 0.01 m²/s, giving a Reynolds number of 5.
The domain dimensions and cylinder position follow standard flow-past-cylinder conventions (e.g., domain at least 10 diameters upstream and 20 diameters downstream of the cylinder, with the cylinder centered in the transverse direction).
No turbulence model is used; the laminar option in transportProperties is set to on.
The simulation is transient, using a time step and end time appropriate for resolving the steady laminar flow at Re = 5.
The pressure-velocity coupling uses the standard pimpleFoam solver settings (PIMPLE algorithm).
All other case files (fvSchemes, fvSolution, controlDict, transportProperties, etc.) are configured with standard pimpleFoam laminar incompressible settings.
